Crime & Law · India

Kolkata rally, protests, and legal actions reported across India

Kolkata's Martyrs' Day rally proceeded with a large crowd despite a court-imposed cap. Separately, protests related to a paper leak occurred in Bihar, where police reportedly opened fire, injuring three individuals. In West Bengal, the government announced it would invoke the Goonda Act following clashes in Kolkata. The Trinamool Congress (TMC) faces a contempt charge for allegedly violating a high court order regarding the rally. Additionally, an FIR was filed against Abhishek Banerjee for alleged threatening remarks, and a purported video of a clash between Mamata Banerjee and police at the rally went viral.
